newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld slows down new project launch.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld slows down new project launch.

text.p: Real estate developer Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc said on Friday it had decided to slow down the launching of new projects, keeping it to only one for the rest of the year.
Megaworld senior vice president Cirilo Manlangit told reporters it would start pre-selling its medium-rise, middle-cost condominium in suburban Quezon city by October this year.
The project is expected to be completed after two and a half years.
Manlangit said the company had decided to veer away from its previous strategy of launching several condominium projects in succession.
"We decided to be more prudent in our investments," Manlangit said, but added that it was not due to cashflow difficulties which was rumoured in the stock market.
"If we stop building our projects, then the rumour is true," he said. He said all the projects of the company were on schedule.
Megaworld is set to complete ten projects this year, four of which have been completed in the first half of the year.
Manlangit said Megaworld's stock rights was likely to be offered in August.
